profiles.name: scale_normalized_rank3
profiles.interpretation: Quality-favorable mechanism point. It is NOT a whole-model 10x result on this tiny model because fixed/metadata overhead is disproportionately large. The same relative rank maps to rank96/4096 on Mistral, where structural planning remains above 10x.

profiles.name: uniform_rank2_exact_toy_10x
profiles.interpretation: Exact whole-model toy 10x stress point; quality is not acceptable enough to promote as target success.

profiles.name: adaptive_exact_toy_10x
profiles.interpretation: Validation-guided rank allocation improves the exact-budget frontier but the tiny model remains too capacity-starved at whole-model 10x.

claim_boundary: SoftShare is a stronger 10x strategy than hard recursion in controlled tests, but no real pretrained model has been converted/evaluated. The quality-favorable rank3 point is 9.11x whole-model on this tiny geometry; exact toy 10x points have substantially worse quality.
